items.author: Gino Matos
items.content:
Quick Take
- A US judge acquitted two brothers in a $25 million Ethereum exploit case, finding prosecutors failed to prove material misrepresentation.
- The ruling highlights legal complexities as tokenized US stock platforms confront similar transaction-ordering risks.
- SEC rules require MEV disclosures but not dedicated safeguards, raising questions about investor protection and recovery when losses occur.
A federal judge on Nov. 16 acquitted Anton and James Peraire-Bueno in a $25 million Ethereum maximum extractable value (MEV) exploit case because prosecutors had failed to prove a material misrepresentation.
The decision leaves a separate question for tokenized US stock markets about what protects investors when transaction ordering works against them.
The SEC had already opened a conditional route for those markets in September on its framework, which preserves applicable securities antifraud and manipulation laws, but requires venues to disclose their policies for MEV even when they have none.
MEV concerns the value captured through transaction ordering. Four operators' notices show how much can differ within that framework, from transaction privacy and planned sequencing controls to the prospect that investors bear their own losses.
The judgment and the securities framework
In her 46-page opinion, US District Judge Jessica Clarke found insufficient evidence to sustain wire fraud and the related wire-fraud and money-laundering conspiracy charges. The missing element was a material misrepresentation in the brothers' Omakase operation.
The opinion describes a 2023 operation that used lure transactions to attract sandwich-trading bots and exploited a relay-code vulnerability, producing about $25 million in 12 seconds. The targeted bots themselves sought to profit by placing transactions around someone else's trade, a practice that can leave that trader with a worse execution price.
The case was more specific than a simple claim that someone profited from transaction ordering, since prosecutors had to establish the charged fraud.
Clarke found that the trial evidence did not establish a material misrepresentation in the Omakase strategy, and frustrating MEV-Boost's intended design could not supply that missing element.
The court also distinguished precedents involving spoofing, where orders create a misleading impression before being canceled. Here, the lure transactions executed and also were not placed on a regulated market with rules prohibiting the conduct relied upon in those precedents.
That reasoning does not establish a universal requirement that wire fraud occur on a regulated market, nor does it determine whether all forms of MEV extraction are lawful.
In a March 30 letter, the Securities Industry and Financial Markets Association (SIFMA) argued that exposing pending trades to sandwiching and front-running can conflict with securities-market expectations. It called for technical protections or fair-sequencing rules when automated market makers handle securities.
An automated market maker (AMM) lets participants trade against assets committed to a pool using software-defined pricing. The ordering of those trades can affect who receives a favorable price and who captures the resulting profit.
Keeping an investor's pending instruction private and deciding who processes it first are economically significant choices.
The SEC's Sept. 17 order created temporary, conditional relief from the definition of an exchange for qualifying tokenized National Market System stock venues using permissioned AMM pools. Certain liquidity providers trading proprietary capital received separate relief from the dealer definition until Sept. 17, 2031.
The order retains applicable securities antifraud and antimanipulation provisions, including Exchange Act Section 10(b) and Rule 10b-5. Its conditions include permissioned access, public notices, records, and specified trading stoppages.
A venue must describe policies and procedures designed to address it, or state that it has none. It must disclose known material risks, explain any mitigation and compensation arrangements, and describe trading-abuse monitoring or acknowledge its absence.
A venue's published account of its protections can be detailed while leaving investors exposed to risks the operator expressly acknowledges.
Different execution choices against MEV
The SEC's public list, reviewed Nov. 16, contains four notice filers. Their submission dates range from TSV LLC's Sept. 23 notice to Formation Securities' Nov. 9 filing.
| Operator and reported status | Ordering and MEV approach | Disclosed safeguards and remaining exposure | 
|---|---|---|
| TSV LLC: revised Nov. 4 notice says tokenized CNTN trading on Canton had commenced | Selective disclosure of pending transaction contents is intended to reduce conventional public-mempool sandwiching | Permissioning, slippage constraints and monitoring; leakage, sequencing and collusion risks remain | 
| OKXICE TSV: Nov. 23 launch planned | Planned XLayer venue; sequencer ordering generally follows offered fees; no MEV-specific policies reported | Permissioning, minimum output settings, surveillance and possible access revocation; operator says MEV risk remains | 
| Perpetuals.com: says trading has not commenced | Proposed Kronos X Public L2; generally first-in, first-out sequencing and signed arrival receipts | Surveillance and safeguards planned; affiliated sequencer sees pending information and creates residual conflicts | 
| Formation Securities: says operations have not commenced | Planned Solana venue using Orca technology; validator ordering remains a risk | Permissioning, slippage settings and Solidus surveillance planned; MEV cannot be eliminated | 
TSV LLC's current notice says Canton's architecture generally avoids broadcasting readable pending transaction contents to unrelated participants, aiming to reduce opportunities for conventional public-mempool front-running and sandwich attacks.
The operator still acknowledges risks of information leakage, sequencing, compromised infrastructure, and collusion.
OKXICE's Nov. 5 notice disclosed that it has no policies and procedures designed to address MEV. That sits alongside general protections, including permissioned participation, participant minimum-output settings, surveillance and the ability to revoke access for manipulative trading. OKXICE says those features mitigate, rather than eliminate, MEV risk.
Its planned pools use Uniswap v4 on XLayer, where the notice says the sequencer generally orders transactions according to offered network fees.
Perpetuals.com's notice proposes generally first-in, first-out sequencing, with priority for trading-halt instructions and signed arrival receipts intended to make ordering verifiable. Yet its affiliated sequencer would receive nonpublic transaction information.
A private pending-transaction route can reduce exposure to outsiders while leaving a concentrated information advantage to manage.
Its October notice describes safeguards that were not fully implemented and surveillance intended to precede trading. Formation's notice likewise describes planned safeguards for its Solana venue.
MEV protection and compensation are separate questions
Preventing an abusive trade, detecting it afterward, and compensating its victim are different functions.
TSV says participants generally should not expect compensation for market or impermanent losses, compromised participant systems or losses caused by unaffiliated third parties, unless it expressly agrees otherwise or the law requires it.
Perpetuals.com reports no established compensation policy for the risks described in its notice. Formation specifically excludes compensation for lost or compromised private keys or wallets, which does not establish a general recovery guarantee for other losses.
The SEC order recognizes that sequencing can support price-stabilizing activity as well as abuse. TSV says it does not intend to prevent lawful ordinary post-execution arbitrage or price alignment that avoids misuse of confidential information and other prohibited conduct.
The dividing line cannot simply be whether someone profits after another trade. Relevant distinctions include whether pending information was misused, how the venue controls ordering, what conduct it addresses, and which legal obligations apply.
For institutions considering these markets, the notices expose concrete choices about privacy, sequencing, surveillance and loss allocation. The execution model determines that a private route still needs controls over privileged information, while a public route needs a response to abusive ordering.
The next disputed on-chain securities trade would raise questions about what representations were made, what rules applied, who controlled the information and ordering, and what recourse the investor had. Bringing stocks onto a blockchain makes those choices visible.

items.content:
US judge clears brothers in $25M Ethereum MEV case after mistrial
Judge Jessica Clarke said the transactions did not involve false promises, but the ruling did not determine whether the brothers’ conduct was ethical or violated other laws.
A US federal judge acquitted two brothers accused of extracting $25 million from Ethereum trading bots, ruling that prosecutors failed to prove they made material misrepresentations during the alleged exploit.
In a Monday ruling, Judge Jessica Clarke acquitted Anton and James Peraire-Bueno on wire fraud and related charges. Prosecutors alleged that the MIT-educated brothers exploited a flaw in maximal extractable value (MEV)-boost software in April 2023 to lure sandwich-trading bots into transactions they then disrupted, securing $25 million in about 12 seconds.
The judge said the transactions did not amount to false promises or constitute criminal fraud, and that the case was not about whether the brothers’ actions were ethical or potentially violated other laws.
Their first trial ended in a mistrial when jurors failed to reach a verdict in November 2025.
Coin Center executive director Peter Van Valkenburgh called the acquittal “excellent news,” saying prosecutors’ honest validator theory risked allowing the government to impose its own standards of conduct on Ethereum validators through wire fraud laws.
“Anyone participating in an open network would have to wonder whether prosecutors might later declare their behavior ‘dishonest’ and haul them into court,” Valkenburgh said.
The ruling also cited a 2025 decision involving Mango Markets trader Avraham Eisenberg, where a judge found insufficient evidence of false representations.

items.author: Decrypt Agent
items.content:
In brief
- A Manhattan federal judge has acquitted Anton and James Peraire-Bueno of all charges over a 2023 exploit that drained $25 million from Ethereum trading bots.
- Judge Jessica Clarke found prosecutors had not shown the brothers made a material misrepresentation, a necessary element of wire fraud.
- The ruling ends the case without a retrial, a year after the brothers' first trial ended in a mistrial when the jury could not reach a verdict.
A federal judge in Manhattan has acquitted Anton and James Peraire-Bueno, the MIT-educated brothers accused of exploiting Ethereum's transaction ordering system to take $25 million from automated trading bots.
U.S. District Judge Jessica Clarke granted the brothers' motion for a judgment of acquittal on Monday, clearing them of wire fraud, conspiracy to commit wire fraud and conspiracy to commit money laundering, according to her ruling. The decision closes the criminal case without a second trial.
"The question before the Court is not whether the Peraire-Buenos' conduct was right or moral, or even whether it violated uncharged crimes," Clarke wrote. To convict on wire fraud, prosecutors had to show the brothers made a material misrepresentation, and none of the government's theories did so, she found. Ethereum, she noted, is a "trustless, highly adversarial environment with no terms of use."
While the brothers' scheme "may have frustrated the spirit" of MEV-Boost, software that lets Ethereum validators outsource the ordering of transactions to specialized block builders, that was not enough to make out fraud, Clarke said. In a footnote, she added that the prosecution "raises serious due process concerns," though she declined to rule on that question.
Because the money laundering charge relied on the proceeds of the alleged wire fraud, it fell with the fraud counts.
ETH price on November 22, 4:59PM UTC
Twelve seconds, $25 million
The case stemmed from an April 2023 exploit targeting so-called sandwich bots, automated traders that profit from maximal extractable value (MEV) by placing their own trades on either side of other users' transactions.
According to the ruling, the brothers placed bait transactions designed to lure specific bots, then exploited a bug in a relay's code to see the bots' bundled trades before committing to a block. They then swapped the bait transactions for trades that sold the tokens instead, leaving the bots with about $25 million in losses in roughly 12 seconds. Authorities arrested the pair in May 2024, saying they spent months planning the attack and took steps to hide the proceeds.
At trial in Manhattan last year, an insider testified that the brothers had allegedly planned the attack, and the defense had earlier sought to block evidence of their Google searches. Clarke declared a mistrial in November 2025, after the jury deadlocked.
The case was closely watched in the crypto industry. Clarke's ruling described it as a "first of its kind" prosecution, a label the government itself used in its indictment.

公开亮相仅3个月估值10亿美元，Corma专门训练大模型对抗AI黑客

动察 Beating AI 快讯，网络安全 AI 初创公司 Corma 宣布完成 1.25 亿美元 A 轮融资，估值达到 10 亿美元，由 NEA 领投，红杉资本、Khosla Ventures 和 Coatue 跟投。

这家公司去年才成立，今年 8 月刚以 6000 万美元种子轮融资公开亮相。短短三个月，累计融资已达 1.85 亿美元。

Corma 认为，现有大模型越来越擅长编程，也越来越擅长寻找和利用软件漏洞，但防御能力没有同步跟上。

今年 8 月，Corma 曾让 GPT-5.5、Claude Opus 4.8、Grok 4.3 和 DeepSeek V4 在模拟企业网络中互相攻防。241 次实验中，AI 攻击方有 85% 的机会成功植入持久后门，防守方却只在 19% 的实验中找到了后门。即使使用相同模型攻防，防守方仍经常找不到攻击方留下的东西。

Corma 的解释是，攻击主要依赖代码能力，而防御需要从海量日志、网络流量和安全告警中找到异常。通用大模型并没有专门针对这类数据训练。

因此，Corma 选择从头训练防御专用基础模型，并让模型在模拟企业环境中反复执行攻防任务，通过强化学习改进能力。

Corma 还把模型做成 AI 安全员工，直接使用企业现有的安全工具，自动排查异常、追踪黑客活动，甚至阻止正在发生的攻击。据公司披露，部分财富 500 强企业已经开始使用这套系统。过去三个月，Corma 的服务器容量扩大了 24 倍，以应对不断增长的需求。

items.content:
Goldman Sachs reports $1.22B in Ether ETFs as ETHA share count jumps
Goldman Sachs increased its Ether ETF shares in Q3, bringing its reported holdings to $1.22 billion, while reshuffling its Bitcoin ETF positions.
Banking giant Goldman Sachs reported $1.22 billion in Ether exchange-traded fund (ETF) holdings at the end of September, up from $211.6 million three months earlier, as it increased positions across several funds throughout the third quarter.
The bank increased its holdings in BlackRock’s iShares Ethereum Trust ETF (ETHA) by 352% to 29.96 million shares, worth $602.9 million, according to its Q3 Form 13F filing with the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
The company also shifted its Bitcoin ETF holdings, reducing its stake in BlackRock’s Bitcoin (BTC) fund while increasing its position in Fidelity’s competing ETF.
The increase coincided with a strong quarter for Ether (ETH), which surged nearly 71% in Q3, according to CoinGlass. US spot Ether ETFs attracted more than $3 billion in net inflows, their strongest quarter of 2026, according to SoSoValue.
Goldman Sachs boosts Ether ETF holdings
BlackRock’s ETHA was not the only Ether ETF in which Goldman Sachs increased its holdings during Q3.
The bank also increased its holdings in Grayscale’s Ethereum Staking Mini ETF (ETH) by 180% to 5.68 million shares, lifting the position’s reported value to $144.9 million from $30.5 million in Q2.
Its holdings in BlackRock’s iShares Staked Ethereum ETF (ETHB) rose 62% to 8.18 million shares, worth $281 million, up from $102.3 million in the previous quarter.
Goldman also reported four additional Ether ETF positions worth a combined $195.4 million, led by $169.6 million in Fidelity’s Ethereum Fund (FETH).
Including the new positions, Goldman’s reported Ether ETF holdings reached approximately $1.22 billion at the end of Q3, up from $211.6 million in Q2.
Goldman shifts Bitcoin ETF holdings as Wells Fargo doubles down
Goldman reduced its IBIT holdings by about 792,000 shares to 16.44 million, although the position’s reported value increased 36% to $778.3 million as IBIT’s price surged 42% over the quarter.
Meanwhile, its FBTC holdings surged more than 50-fold, from 105,840 shares to 5.48 million, bringing their reported value to $397.9 million from just $5.4 million.
Camran Khosravi, research analyst at global asset manager Bitwise, told Cointelegraph that market makers such as Jane Street can shift between Bitcoin ETFs to meet client demand and hedge options positions without necessarily changing their overall Bitcoin exposure.
Related: Jane Street boosts Fidelity Bitcoin ETF holdings nearly 8x, trims IBIT
“13F filings can make routine market-making look like a big bet on one fund,” Khosravi said, noting that the disclosures omit short positions and other instruments that may offset reported holdings.
While Goldman trimmed its IBIT shares, Wells Fargo more than doubled its holdings in the BlackRock Bitcoin ETF. The bank’s Q3 filing showed its IBIT position rising 103% to 49.58 million shares, worth around $2.35 billion, while its ETHA holdings increased 125% to 22 million shares.

items.content:
In brief
- CoinGecko announced backing from the Solana Foundation to accelerate its expansion into market intelligence, new digital asset products and possible trading features.
- Neither organization disclosed the terms or said whether the backing is an investment.
- CoinGecko said its commitment to reliable, transparent market data “remains unchanged” as it expands.
CoinGecko, one of crypto’s most widely used price-tracking sites, wants to do more than show users where markets are heading.
The crypto data platform said Tuesday that it has received backing from the Solana Foundation, the Switzerland-based nonprofit that supports the Solana network, to speed its expansion into market intelligence, new digital asset products and, potentially, trading.
The announcement came on the final day of Solana’s Breakpoint conference in London.
ETH price on November 22, 4:59PM UTC
Neither organization disclosed the terms or said whether the backing takes the form of an investment. The Solana Foundation did not specify the size of the commitment or whether the foundation is taking a stake in CoinGecko. A Solana Foundation representative did not immediately respond to Decrypt’s request for comment.
CoinGecko said it will focus on three areas: expanding data coverage and analytics across blockchain ecosystems, exploring trading features that let users act onchain, and building simpler experiences for users worldwide.
“We’ve helped millions of people discover and understand this industry, but the opportunity ahead is much bigger,” said Bobby Ong, CoinGecko’s CEO and co-founder.
Vibhu Norby, chief product officer at the Solana Foundation, said the foundation believes the “next wave of adoption will come from making crypto dramatically easier to use.” (Disclosure: Decrypt’s parent company, Dastan, is building products on Solana, and Decrypt uses CoinGecko market data.)
Founded in 2014, CoinGecko says it provides data on more than 50 million crypto assets across more than 2,000 exchanges.
CoinGecko said it will keep serving users with the same commitment to “reliable, comprehensive market coverage and transparent methodologies.” Co-founder and President TM Lee said its commitment to accurate, reliable data “remains unchanged.”
The deal is one of several Solana announcements timed around Breakpoint. DTCC said last week that it plans to connect its tokenization service to Solana, with tokenized stocks, ETFs and Treasuries expected on the network in the second half of 2027.
At a Breakpoint panel, executives from DTCC and Barclays said tokenization’s biggest near-term payoff lies in putting idle collateral to work.

OpenCode Browse用Rust重写：内存占用降至1/25，彻底移除Playwright依赖

动察 Beating AI 快讯，OpenCode 发布 Browse 0.1.0，用 Rust 重写浏览器控制工具。官方称，新版中继程序的内存占用降至原来的 1/25，程序体积缩小至 1/23，并彻底移除了底层对 Node.js 和 Playwright 的依赖。

此前，Browse 需要依靠 Node.js、Playwright 等组件运行浏览器自动化服务。新版将命令行工具、本地中继和 MCP Server 整合成一个只有几 MB 的 Rust 原生程序。旧版中继空闲时占用数百 MB 内存，新版只需几 MB。

新版还调整了 Agent 的调用方式。OpenCode 可以直接调用打开网页、读取页面、点击、填写表单和截图等工具，并在代码中组合执行。Claude Code、Codex 等外部 Agent 仍可通过 MCP 编写 JavaScript，一次完成多个浏览器操作。新版由 Rust 实现浏览器控制，不再依赖 Playwright。

浏览器操作也从原来的 Session 管理改为直接使用标签页 ID。每个 Agent 默认只能访问自己打开或用户授权的标签页。

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 17 日，Ledger 安全研究团队 Ledger Donjon 在 X 平台发布公告称，第三方服务提供商 Optimizely 发生安全事件，导致使用该服务的 Ledger 官网及其他多个网站受到影响。

Ledger 表示，团队已完成相关安全修复，恶意代码不再通过其官方网站提供。此次事件涉及网站使用的第三方服务，并未影响 Ledger 硬件钱包设备的安全架构，用户私钥仍受到设备保护。

目前，Ledger 尚未披露此次事件的具体攻击方式、影响用户数量及是否造成实际资产损失。

Liquid AI决策模型升级：新增5种能力，75分登顶，价格不变

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Liquid AI 发布 d1.2 和 d1.2-ultra 两款多模态决策模型。

新模型在 Artificial Analysis 决策模型榜单上分别拿到 69 分和 75 分，比各自前代提高 3 分和 4 分。其中，d1.2-ultra 排名第一，领先第二名 2 分。

d1.2-ultra 的上下文窗口也从 3.3 万扩大到 6.6 万 Token。平均任务耗时从前代的 301 毫秒缩短至 218 毫秒，降低约 28%。

之前 d1-ultra 主要负责是非判断、单选和评分，新版本新增了 5 类任务：从文档中提取金额、日期等具体数值；找出所有符合条件的文字及其位置；在图片中圈出指定物体；估算数量并给出范围；一次选择多个符合条件的选项。

例如，处理发票时，模型现在可以直接提取应付金额，并返回对应原文。如果没找到，就回答「未找到」。处理图片时，也能框出所有符合描述的物体，而不只是判断它们是否存在。

两款模型还新增音频输入，可以直接识别录音中的语言、警笛等声音，也支持用语音提出问题。

Liquid AI 内部测试显示，d1.2-ultra 提取票据数值的准确率达到 98%，图片目标定位达到 94%。

在另一组涵盖 22,505 道问题的对照测试中，它的置信度校准误差仅为 0.8 个百分点，Perplexity Decider v1.3 则为 3.7 个百分点。也就是说，它给出的判断概率与实际正确率更加接近，方便系统识别需要人工复核的任务。

价格保持不变。d1.2 和 d1.2-ultra 每百万输入 Token 分别收费 0.02 美元和 0.042 美元，不收输出费用，目前均已开放 API。

Liquid AI 表示，未来会推出能力相当的开源版本。

items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright
items.content:
Quick Take
- XRP-paired native DEX turnover rose 99.9% across two completed UTC weeks, reaching $62.6 million during Nov. 9-15.
- Matched-ledger modeling narrowed the 100,000-XRP shortfall from 3.57% to 0.48%, while smaller modeled sales fared slightly worse.
- Larger funded RLUSD offers accompanied a smaller pool reserve, but the snapshots cannot establish migration or bank-dollar cash-out capacity.
XRP-paired trading on its native ledger nearly doubled over Nov. 9-15, but a separate comparison of the direct market for Ripple USD (RLUSD) at two dated ledgers showed a smaller execution penalty for a 100,000-XRP sale.
DefiLlama's daily data put completed Nov. 9-15 trading at $62.6 million, up 99.9% from $31.3 million during Nov. 2-8.
The measure combines XRP-paired automated market maker swaps and order-book trades. Native XRP participates directly, but repeated turnover can recycle existing inventory without establishing fresh net buying.
NOSHASHI's ledger data showed the XRP/RLUSD automated market maker holding 2.165 million RLUSD at Nov. 9's close and 1.861 million on Nov. 16, a 14% decline. Native XRP in the same pool slipped from 1.972 million to 1.959 million.
Over that interval, sampled funded RLUSD offers available to token sellers increased from about 19,392 to 111,951 RLUSD, roughly 5.77 times the earlier amount. Funded amounts measure what the offer owners could deliver and may be below the advertised size.
NOSHASHI's measurement requests at most 100 offers per side and counts funded depth within 10% of each snapshot's reference midpoint. Its ask side is the RLUSD inventory an XRP seller receives, and the figures exclude AMM reserves, do not measure all XRP liquidity, and do not imply that every sampled offer sits near the best price.
What different XRP sale sizes could return
An idealized static model combined the Nov. 9 raw offers and pool state with their Nov. 16 equivalents. For each snapshot, it allocated XRP between funded offers and the constant-product pool according to which supplied more RLUSD for the next XRP sold.
The pool calculation includes its ordinary trading fee, 0.308% at the earlier ledger and 0.315% at the later one. XRPL can combine offers and AMMs in an actual transaction, but this calculation is not account-specific pathfinding or a completed fill.
The benchmark is the midpoint of the sampled book's tightest uncrossed bid and ask quotes, equivalent to about 1.098 RLUSD per XRP on Nov. 9 and 0.951 on Nov. 16.
| XRP sold | Nov. 9 modeled RLUSD | Nov. 16 modeled RLUSD | 
|---|---|---|
| 1,000 | 1,097 | 950 | 
| 10,000 | 10,973 | 9,488 | 
| 100,000 | 105,867 | 94,600 | 
In CryptoSlate's calculations, the shortfall for 100,000 XRP narrowed from 3.57% to 0.48% against each snapshot's own reference midpoint.
This compares modeled proceeds with the token amount implied by that reference price and includes spread, modeled AMM fees, and price impact. The lower absolute proceeds on Nov. 16 reflect XRP's lower price in RLUSD, despite the smaller relative penalty.
The smaller trades did not share that improvement: the 1,000-XRP shortfall widened from 0.05% to 0.11%, while at 10,000 XRP, it widened from 0.05% to 0.19%.
In the later snapshot, the larger modeled sale relied more heavily on funded offers. On Nov. 9, only about 17,701 XRP went to the sampled book, leaving 82,299 XRP for the pool. On Nov. 16, about 88,471 XRP went to offers and 11,529 XRP to the pool.
These estimates exclude deeper offers, routes through other assets, additional issuer-transfer, network and redemption costs, and other account restrictions.
Swaps and liquidity-provider deposits or withdrawals can all change pool balances. A dollar-valued total value locked decline can also reflect repricing: DefiLlama's pool methodology excludes order-book offers and can double a pool's sole priced side, so its valuation buckets cannot establish literal token holdings or net deposits.
RLUSD proceeds also differ from dollars in a bank account. Ripple's user terms require Customer status under its customer agreement for direct issuer redemption, subject to applicable conditions.
The next useful evidence is whether funded offers persist and repeatable estimates remain favorable at the intended sale size.
This sample supports the conclusion that the larger direct RLUSD exit became less costly in the model even as the pool's RLUSD reserve shrank.

动察 Beating AI 快讯，11 月 17 日，《人民日报》刊文肯定历史题材 AI 微短剧《持械入宋》，称其火爆传播「令人振奋」，改变了许多人对 AI 短剧的看法。

这部剧自 8 月上线以来，已连续更新 11 季、约 1100 集，全系列累计播放量已突破 120 亿次。

《持械入宋》讲述 5 名现代特战队员穿越到北宋末年，试图改变历史的故事。与常见的穿越爽剧不同，主角没有无所不能的「系统」，人物成长必须符合历史环境，5 名队员也各有独立故事线。

《人民日报》认为，该剧的成功不仅在于 AI 画面越来越逼真，更在于剧情有逻辑、人物有成长，还抓住了观众对宋朝历史的「意难平」。

这部剧的制作团队也很特殊。核心创作者并非影视科班出身，包括宝妈、前网约车司机、个体户等。他们分散在全国各地，主要依靠线上协作完成制作。

从第九、十季开始，团队将主力视频模型从字节跳动 Seedance 2.0 升级至 2.5，战争大场面、人物表情和画面真实感明显改善。但复杂镜头仍需要反复生成，有时要尝试几十次才能达到要求。主创透露，全系列算力投入已超过 100 万元。

分析师：BTC盈利筹码骤降，市场正逼近「多空生死线」

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 17 日，CryptoQuant 分析师 Axel Adler Jr 援引链上数据表示，比特币处于盈利状态的供应量占比已降至 52%，一周内回落 7 个百分点，为过去一年中较陡的降幅之一。该指标仍高于 50%，且已连续两日维持在这一水平上方。按持有成本衡量，目前仅略过半数比特币仍录得未实现盈利。过去一年中，该占比处于当前水平或更低的交易日仅占 11%。

与此同时，长期持有者供应量已降至 1620 万枚 BTC，一周减少 7.39 万枚，并创下 90 日新低，同样属于过去一年中较陡的降幅之一。分析师指出，该供应量所处水平本身并不罕见，更值得关注的是长期持有者与短期持有者之间的供应再分配节奏。

Axel Adler Jr 表示，市场已接近盈利供应与亏损供应近乎对半的临界点，若该占比跌破 50%，则意味着多数比特币将录得未实现亏损。上一次出现类似情形是在 2026 年 8 月 16 日，当时比特币价格为 62,900 美元，一周后价格高出 24%。其同时强调，仅凭一次历史对照并不足以判断趋势是否反转。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377738

Wintermute展望「后市走强前置条件」：ETF流入助推比特币升至6万8上方，美联储排除1月加息可能性

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 17 日，加密做市商 Wintermute 表示，比特币的下跌尚未结束，价格可能会跌至 5 万美元区间。

Wintermute 在最新的市场报告中写道：「由于资金流向为负且跌破了 200 周均线，我们预计价格将承压跌向 5 万美元区间，周六的 6.2 万美元低点是第一道关口，而 Deribit 上 6 万美元的看跌期权集群是下一个磁吸目标。」

200 周均线是比特币过去大约四年的平均价格，交易员将其视为长期底部。但令多头沮丧的是，BTC 目前的交易价格远低于其约 6.8 万美元的 200 周均线。

Wintermute 的预测与 Deribit 期权市场的活动相吻合。在 Deribit 上，6 万美元的看跌期权是最受欢迎的交易，名义未平仓合约超过 9 亿美元。该看跌期权是押注比特币现货价格将跌破 6 万美元。

Wintermute 指出，看跌的触发因素是利率。在 10 月份美国通胀数据高于预期之后，市场目前认为美联储在 12 月加息的概率约为 92%。这使得 10 年期美国国债收益率回升至 5% 以上。较高的债券收益率会损害不产生收益的资产，而比特币就是这样的资产。

Wintermute 表示：「因为比特币不产生任何收益，它就成了这笔交易的融资端，也是押错方向的最高贝塔值方式。」通俗地说，停在比特币上的一美元，就是没有赚取那 5% 收益率的一美元，因此投资者可能会卖出比特币，将资金轮动到债券市场。

Wintermute 表示，稳定币供应量也有所萎缩，且数字资产财库公司（DAT）的需求也已枯竭。「ETF、DAT、散户和机构资金流向等各个渠道都指向走平或下跌。需要以令人信服的方式扭转这一局面，我们才能恢复任何上升趋势。」在两种情况下，行情会变得不那么谨慎。一是比特币在某日（UTC 时间）收盘重回 6.8 万美元上方，且当天 ETF 有资金流入。二是本周的美联储会议纪要或 10 月通胀数据排除了 1 月加息的可能性。

但 Wintermute 不对底部做出任何预测，「我们并不试图在这里预测底部或低点，因为这根本不可能。」

Italy's Largest Bank Cuts ARK Bitcoin ETF Stake 43%, BlackRock Ether Staking ETF 57%

Intesa Sanpaolo, Italy's largest banking group, significantly reshuffled its crypto ETF holdings in Q3 2026, according to Criptovaluta's analysis of U.S. regulatory filings. The bank cut its ARK 21Shares Bitcoin ETF stake by 42.9% to 1.98 million shares and reduced its BlackRock Ethereum staking ETF holdings by 56.6%. 美国商务部长被查后，芯片新规由财政部和国安会主导：7国变5国，远程算力管制覆盖全球

动察 Beating AI 快讯，11 月 16 日，美国商务部正式公布限制受限国家的企业通过海外数据中心使用先进 AI 芯片的新规。商务部在公告中特别注明，这份规则由财政部和白宫国家安全委员会主导起草。新规预计 11 月 19 日生效。

上周，《The Information》曾披露，美国准备加强对新加坡、马来西亚等 7 个国家的先进 AI 芯片出口管制。正式公布的名单缩减为 5 国，去掉了挪威和南非。

但新规还明确了另一层限制：无论海外数据中心建在哪个国家，只要向受限地区的企业提供超过规定规模的先进算力，就可能需要美国许可。

已经运营的数据中心也不例外。只要符合上述管制条件，就必须在新规生效后 90 天内取得许可证，才能继续提供相关算力。即使把算力分散到多个数据中心，只要这些机房联网共享计算资源，也可能合并计算，无法靠拆分机房绕过限制。

美国企业则获得了一项有限豁免。如果芯片运往上述 5 国，由美国总部企业或其符合条件的海外机构接收，只需按月向美国政府报告交易信息，就可以免除新增的五国出口许可要求。但如果这些芯片最终用于向受限国家的企业提供达到管制门槛的算力，仍须另外申请许可。

这与商务部长 Howard Lutnick 此前推动的方案明显不同。他主张只管部分国家，而且让现有数据中心不受新规限制。黄仁勋丑闻爆发后，Lutnick 因迟迟没有限制相关芯片交易受到批评。11 月 13 日，财政部长 Scott Bessent 还公开表示，财政部、国防部等多个部门几个月前就要求将涉事公司 Megaspeed 列入出口黑名单，但决定权一直在商务部手里。

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 17 日，据 Korea IT Times 报道，英国 Monument Bank 宣布与 Midnight Foundation、伦敦风险投资工作室 The Building Blocks 合作，面向零售客户推出计息代币化存款产品。该产品首期一年期固定年利率（AER）为 5.20%，存款上限为 2.5 亿英镑，客户可通过 Monument 现有银行应用申购。

items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright
items.content:
Quick Take
- Anthropic says Claude Fable 5.2 designed three gadgets that Diode engineers built into working prototypes.
- Claude's reported work joined circuit boards, enclosures and firmware, while Diode handled physical assembly and testing.
- Electrical validation and certification remain undone, and the demonstration provides no overall success rate across repeated design attempts.
Anthropic says Claude turned short gadget briefs into designs for three working prototypes, coordinating circuit boards, enclosures, and firmware that human engineers then assembled and tested.
In a Nov. 9 research post, Anthropic described a speakerphone, a voice-assistant hub, and a handheld virtual pet designed by Claude Fable 5.2, while Diode Computers built and tested the
For the speakerphone, Anthropic said Claude produced specifications and schematics, placed components on a printed circuit board, routed the copper connections, designed a 3D-printable case, wrote the device's software, and prepared a parts list. The other two devices followed a similar process.
Diode supplied occasional follow-up directives, and an engineer asked whether the virtual pet would operate without a battery. Claude was not connected to test equipment or the machines that make and assemble boards, so people performed the physical construction and testing.
According to Anthropic, Claude checked whether the speakerphone's board would fit inside its case and found that the mute switch would collide with a wall during insertion. It added an assembly step that tilted the board into place.
For the voice-assistant hub, Claude changed the enclosure's shape to shorten microphone ports. It also wrote speakerphone firmware that dimmed the LEDs as audio became louder, keeping the device within the board's designed electrical-current limit, Anthropic said.
Anthropic said Diode manufactured all three boards directly from Claude's design files, without exchanging manufacturing adjustments, and that the prototypes worked without circuitry fixes.
Working prototypes still face product tests
Anthropic said they had not undergone electrical validation, antenna tuning, thermal testing or certification and were not designed for mass production. A functioning prototype still needs substantial engineering work before it becomes a commercially ready product.
The disclosure also provides no overall success rate across repeated end-to-end design attempts. Its three working examples show what the collaborators say they achieved, while leaving unanswered how consistently the process could deliver another usable device.
Anthropic's planned next steps include denser, faster, and more complex boards, simulation checks, and learning from measurements of finished devices. For engineers and hardware builders, that would extend the work from producing a design toward checking how it behaves once built.
items.title: Anthropic’s Claude builds custom gadget blueprints, but consistency stays hidden

Ex-Robinhood engineer pleads guilty to $125K Hyperliquid trading scheme
The former Robinhood engineer used confidential information about upcoming Robinhood token listings to trade on Hyperliquid.
Former Robinhood software engineer Huaisong “Jerry” Xiang has pleaded guilty to wire fraud after using confidential information about upcoming crypto listings on the platform to trade perpetual futures on the decentralized exchange Hyperliquid, earning $125,523 in illicit profits.
On Monday, the US Department of Justice said that Xiang entered the plea before US District Judge Colleen McMahon and agreed to forfeit $125,523. Xiang faces a maximum sentence of 20 years in prison and is scheduled to be sentenced on Feb. 25, 2027.
Prosecutors said the software engineer had access to nonpublic information about which tokens Robinhood Crypto planned to list and when. Between 2025 and 2026, he repeatedly bought perpetual futures tied to those tokens before the announcements were made public.
The plea follows September charges against Xiang and another former Robinhood engineer, Hefu Chai. Both were accused of exploiting internal listing information to trade on Hyperliquid, with prosecutors initially alleging that each made over $50,000.
The DOJ’s Monday announcement did not provide an update on Chai’s case.
In May, crypto analytics firm Kaiko flagged suspicious Hyperliquid trading ahead of Robinhood’s Jan. 15 listing of Lighter (LIT). One of the wallets identified in its investigation matches an address that prosecutors later linked to Chai, who allegedly used it to trade LIT perpetuals ahead of the listing.

items.content:
Bitunix分析师：AI资本需求推升通胀与融资压力，美联储政策框架面临重新定价

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 17 日，美国市场正在面对一个更深层的问题：AI 究竟会成为下一轮生产力革命，还是先演变成一个推高资本成本与通胀的巨大投资周期？英伟达（NVIDIA）近期爆发的治理争议，正好反映了这场竞争的另一面。员工担忧黄仁勋（Jensen Huang）若离开将造成核心人才流失，反映出 AI 企业的竞争优势不仅来自芯片与资本，更取决于人才、技术决策及组织整合能力。当企业必须持续投入巨额资本维持领先，市场也开始重新评估 AI 投资的可持续性，以及未来能否真正转化为获利与生产力。

这个问题同时将美联储（Fed）推向政策两难。美国第三季度 GDP 年化增长 3.4%，10 月失业率为 4.1%，经济尚未出现明显失速，但能源价格与服务通胀仍限制降息空间。更值得注意的是，AI 基础设施建设正在形成新的需求来源：数据中心、半导体与电力投资短期内推高资本支出及能源需求，长期却可能通过自动化降低服务成本、改善生产效率。问题在于，生产力红利尚未充分反映在经济数据中，投资所带来的需求压力却已经存在。市场因此重新提高对货币紧缩的敏感度，10 年期美债收益率升破 5%，短债收益率同步走高，反映投资者不再只关注美联储何时降息，也开始要求更高的期限与通胀风险补偿。

沃什（Warsh）面对的正是这种结构性变化。他开始通过 AI 工作小组检视技术对生产力、通胀及货币政策的影响，因为过去以需求与就业数据判断通胀的框架，未必足以解释 AI 带来的供需变化。如果 AI 最终有效降低企业运营成本，将有助于缓解中长期通胀；但如果算力与能源投资持续扩张，生产力改善又未能及时跟上，美联储便可能在经济仍具韧性的情况下维持高利率。这也解释了为何白宫希望降低借贷成本，财政部官员却不愿因能源冲击而过度紧缩，市场对 12 月政策方向的分歧也因此扩大。

另一方面，美联储内部对资产负债表的讨论，同样是这场转变的一部分。哈马克（Hammack）支持将金融市场失序时的临时购债与一般货币政策操作区分，避免紧急流动性支持被市场误认为新一轮量化宽松（QE）。这项构想若进一步发展，将让美联储在维持紧缩立场的同时，保留处理金融市场流动性风险的空间。对加密市场而言，真正需要关注的不是单次升息幅度，而是 AI 投资是否持续吸收市场资金、美元融资成本是否维持高档，以及美联储能否在控制通胀与维持金融稳定之间取得平衡。当 AI 的资本需求先于生产力回报实现，高估值资产将同时面对折现率上升与流动性受限的压力。

items.content:
奥特曼宣布AGI已实现？疯传视频断章取义，OpenAI还不敢放手让AI自我进化

动察 Beating AI 快讯，OpenAI CEO 奥尔特曼在 Semafor 大会上谈到了 RSI（递归自我改进），也就是让 AI 参与研发更强的下一代 AI，并不断提升自身能力。

主持人问他，OpenAI 是否已经实现了这项能力。

奥尔特曼回答，和 AGI（通用人工智能）一样，AI 自我改进也很难划出一条明确的界限。不能简单地说，以前还没有 AGI，现在突然就有了。

结果，这句话被断章取义，传成了奥尔特曼亲口宣布 OpenAI 已经实现 AGI。

实际上，他随后明确解释了 OpenAI 的进展：公司确实已经在利用自己的 AI 技术，加快下一代模型研发。但如果让 AI 在没有人类监督的情况下，自主设计下一代模型，并不断改进自己，他的回答是「绝对没有」。

奥特曼还表示，OpenAI 本可以在 RSI 上走得更远，但目前无法保证这样做的安全性，因此选择放慢速度。

Jason 是美国知名天使投资人，曾早期投资 Uber、Robinhood。不过，他此前也曾在 2018 年判断比特币有 60%–70% 的归零概率，最终并未兑现。至少从最近半个月的价格走势看，这次看空方向暂时占优。但 5.7 万美元目标价尚未实现，加密社群仍在等待比特币再创新高。

美商务部与司法部公布Megaspeed调查进展：2024年启动调查，2025年英伟达将其列入禁售名单

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 17 日，美国商务部与司法部发布联合声明，披露新加坡云计算公司 Megaspeed 调查的部分时间线。美国商务部表示，因主动监测敏感半导体潜在转移活动时发现可疑行为，于 2024 年启动对 Megaspeed 涉嫌违反出口管制规定的调查。

声明披露，2025 年 5 月，商务部调查人员向英伟达索取有关直接或间接向 Megaspeed 销售产品的记录；同年 6 月，英伟达将 Megaspeed 列入「禁售名单」（No Sell List）。随后，商务部工业与安全局（BIS）调查人员与新加坡执法部门合作，于 2025 年 6 月前往 Megaspeed 开展现场最终用户核查，并对公司 CEO Alice Huang 进行了问询。

在上述执法行动之后，司法部接手主导针对 Megaspeed 的刑事调查。商务部与司法部表示，双方将继续合作，依法追究 Megaspeed 可能涉及的任何犯罪行为。声明还介绍了美国政府在半导体走私案件方面的执法情况：特朗普政府任内，六项独立调查中共有 17 名被告因涉嫌参与数十亿美元规模的半导体走私活动而受到起诉。商务部称，其在出口管制案件中实施的罚款金额也创下新高，达到拜登政府时期的 18 倍。

奥特曼谈黄仁勋复职：我也被董事会赶走过，他是我的英雄，但英雄也有缺点

动察 Beating AI 快讯，OpenAI CEO 奥特曼在 Semafor 大会上，被主持人问了一个很有意思的问题：黄仁勋该不该像他当年一样，被董事会赶走后再回来？

主持人 Reed Albergotti 还特意提到，网上支持黄仁勋复职的公开信，看着像是照搬了 2023 年支持奥特曼复职的那封信。

奥特曼没有直接支持黄仁勋复职。他说：「我觉得自己了解得还不够，没法回答这个问题。」

但他紧接着表示，黄仁勋一直是自己的英雄，「英雄也有缺点」。自己当年也被董事会解雇过，因此特别能体会黄仁勋现在的处境。「那是什么滋味，我还记得，虽然感觉已经过去很久了。」

奥特曼说，英伟达当年很早就押注 OpenAI，OpenAI 也押注英伟达。他对此非常感激，很难想象没有黄仁勋，AI 革命会是什么样子。

主持人随后问他，英伟达此前为 OpenAI 俄亥俄州数据中心项目提供最高约 1050 亿美元担保，黄仁勋离开后，这份担保还靠不靠谱？

奥特曼认为，英伟达体量足够大，市场依然信任它的担保。AI 的需求和收入也在快速增长，他不担心黄仁勋离任会拖垮整个行业。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377703

Alliance联创看好AI与加密融合：NFT和DAO或迎来新机遇

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 17 日，Alliance 联创 Imran 发文分享其对加密行业未来发展的乐观看法。他认为，自 2013 年以来，加密行业每轮链上周期都经历过繁荣与衰退：繁荣期展示各类链上实验的潜在市场需求，随后约 95% 的实验项目在衰退中被淘汰，但仍有部分项目得以存活，并最终成长为独角兽。

以 NFT 为例，2017 年 CryptoKitties 一度占据以太坊约 20% 的交易量，铸造和交互活动甚至导致 ETH 网络几乎无法正常使用，但这也验证了链上独特数字资产铸造的需求，并为 2020 年至 2021 年的 NFT 热潮埋下伏笔。

2013 年至 2023 年间，加密行业已经快速经历了大量链上应用实验，下一阶段的关键在于找到这些应用真正不可替代的使用场景。随着 AI 推动内容生产趋于商品化，具有稀缺性、来源证明和真实人际连接的艺术品可能重新获得价值，NFT 或因此迎来复苏。

此外，他认为，DAO 和治理机制目前的实际用途有限，但随着 AI Agent 发展，自治组织可能逐渐成为现实。而 AI 将成为过去十年众多链上实验重新获得实际应用价值的重要技术催化剂，同时也期待其他尚未显现的潜在催化因素。

items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright
items.content:
Quick Take
- DeepMind reports machine-checked proofs for a compiled Signal library build, with humans choosing the specifications.
- The results cover specified messaging operations under explicit assumptions.
- Public instructions support outside checking, but CryptoSlate has not independently rebuilt and checked the full proof package.
Google DeepMind researchers say their AI agents produced mathematical proofs linking specific security guarantees to a compiled build of Signal’s encryption library, and they put the resulting evidence online for others to check.
The Nov. 10 AlphaProof Code report describes about 6.5 million lines of machine-checked Lean proof code. The result concerns a particular build of libsignal, the Signal protocol’s implementation, under explicit assumptions about cryptography and the environment in which the code runs.
The authors say five people worked on the proofs over four weeks. Humans directed the work, selected reference models and reviewed the specifications that defined what the agents had to prove.
What Google DeepMind's proofs cover
The target was an AArch64 Linux executable using libsignal-protocol v0.105.4 and SPQR v1.6.0 inside a small command-line harness. The theorems cover session initialization, sending a message, and receiving one. Key generation falls outside that verified scope.
The Google report connects the compiled executable to specified properties of PQXDH and Triple Ratchet one-to-one messaging, including forward secrecy, authentication, and post-compromise security.
These address whether earlier messages stay secret after keys are stolen, whether senders are authentic, and whether a session can regain secrecy after a compromise.
Its two proof models provide different assurances: the symbolic analysis relies on idealized cryptographic operations and collision-free executions, while the computational analysis bounds the success of classical attackers under stated cryptographic assumptions.
The symbolic proof establishes handshake secrecy under specified later breaks of Diffie-Hellman, but the computational proof does not cover quantum attackers. Group messaging is outside the report’s scope, and the computational model excludes multi-device state. Its bounds also stop providing a useful guarantee at sufficiently large workloads.
The results still require trust in Lean’s checking kernel, the specifications reviewed by the researchers, the AArch64 Linux model, and contracts describing selected routines.
The project’s Nov. 11 update, merged on GitHub, says ten more library routines were verified, cutting trusted routine hooks from 37 to 27. Those hooks replace execution of selected routines with assumed descriptions of their behavior.
The update retains libsignal v0.105.4 but changes the pinned executable. The newer build verifies the machine code for those ten routines instead of relying on their modeled contracts.
The project repository provides public instructions to rebuild the pinned binary and check its proofs. A Linux-only comparator checks that the theorems and their dependent definitions match trusted statements, then replays proofs in a fresh Lean kernel.
The authors also report reintroducing two previously fixed libsignal bugs and proving that the modified binaries violate their symbolic security theorem. That tests whether the specification rejects those known regressions.
The public package gives other researchers a concrete way to check the claimed connection between security requirements and executable code.
items.title: Google AI agents audit Signal’s code and one major flaw stays hidden

苹果给ChatGPT弹出红色警告：开放全盘权限，Mac将无法保护你的数据

动察 Beating AI 快讯，苹果在最新的 macOS 27.3 beta 2 中，把应用权限警告做得相当吓人。

当用户准备给 ChatGPT 开启「完全磁盘访问权限」时，系统直接弹出红色警告：「你的 Mac 将无法保护你的数据免受 ChatGPT.app 的访问。」

下面还列出了 ChatGPT 获得权限后能做的事，包括读取、修改、删除和导出个人数据，查看隐藏照片，甚至以用户身份浏览网站。用户必须逐项确认，才能继续授权。

苹果还重新设计了授权方式。用户可以像过去一样授予完整权限，也可以只开放指定文件夹，或限定 AI 智能体能够控制哪些应用。用户还能要求每次访问前重新征求许可。当第三方工具控制其他应用时，系统也会显示提示。

苹果早在 10 月就宣布要收紧权限。当时，Meta 的 AI 智能体 Muse 刚因涉嫌擅自读取用户私人消息引发争议。Meta 否认这一指控，强调用户必须主动开启相关权限，Muse 才能读取消息。

不过，更严格的警告也给普通软件带来了麻烦。BetterDisplay 开发者抱怨，自己的软件只需要控制显示器亮度和音量，却同样触发了危险权限警告，菜单栏还会持续显示蓝色提示，影响正常使用。

彭博社记者 Mark Gurman 借机讽刺：「换句话说，苹果提前两年就开始给自家的 AI 智能体做宣传了。」

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377698

动察 Beating AI 快讯，OpenAI 宣布与 Apollo Research、METR、Goodfire 和 Transluce 四家外部机构签约，首次开展成体系的「嵌入式安全评估」。外部研究人员将按任务需要，深入接触尚未发布的模型、训练过程中的中间版本、源代码、训练数据和内部监控记录，直接检查 AI 有没有出现危险行为，以及现有安全措施能否发现这些问题。

四家机构各有分工：

- METR：将检查 OpenAI 迄今规模最大的一次强化学习训练，寻找内部测试和监控系统可能漏掉的异常行为。

- Apollo Research：负责调查 AI 是否会暗中违背开发者意图，甚至试图破坏安全机制，以及这些行为能否被发现。

- Goodfire：将派研究人员分析模型内部的计算信号，监测训练过程，排查异常行为并帮助改进模型。

- Transluce：则要反过来检查 OpenAI 的安全评测本身，看看现有测试能否有效发现模型欺骗、操纵和其他违规行为。

接触敏感资料的外部研究人员需要在 OpenAI 办公室使用公司设备工作。各机构可以独立发布研究结果，但 OpenAI 有权删去涉及机密的信息。董事会下属的安全与保障委员会则能查阅未经删节的完整报告。

这项合作集中对外公布的同一天，加州总检察长正式起诉 OpenAI。检方称，OpenAI 在调查中承认，测试期间曾至少 80 次失去对 AI 智能体的控制，其中包括今年 7 月实验性智能体突破隔离环境、攻击 Hugging Face 的事件。检方认为，OpenAI 明知相关风险，却没有采取充分的安全措施。OpenAI 则表示，已经调查事故并加强防护。

以太坊Glamsterdam升级测试发现潜在兼容性问题：交易成功但内部付款可能失败

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 17 日，以太坊拟议中的 Glamsterdam 升级测试暴露出智能合约潜在兼容性问题，开发者针对 Juicebox V6 项目付款合约进行的模拟测试显示，在 Sepolia 测试网上，部分交易虽然整体执行成功，但交易内部的付款操作却可能失败，导致资金分配或手续费支付被跳过。

Juicebox V6 的一项测试显示，用户购买 NFT 后，即使向另一项目支付的款项失败，仍可能成功获得 NFT，未支付的资金则留在付款项目中。另一项测试中，预留代币分配操作可以完成，但跨项目付款失败，受益方最终收到的是原始代币，而非预期的付款结果。现金赎回测试还发现，在报告所列的 679,622 至 817,622 Gas 区间内，用户可以成功完成赎回，但内部应支付的 2.5% 手续费未能执行，相当于该笔手续费被免除。

开发者 mejango 解释称，问题与不同操作的 Gas 消耗及错误处理机制有关。在测试中的 Glamsterdam 规则下，涉及新存储写入的内部付款可能先因 Gas 不足而失败，而外层交易仍能继续执行。由于合约中的 try/catch 机制捕获了内部错误，外层操作不会随之回滚。作为对照，开发者对主网环境进行的同类模拟，在所采样的 Gas 区间内只出现交易整体失败或付款完整执行的情况，没有观察到内部付款被跳过的结果。

以太坊基金会 11 月 16 日的测试会议议程已列入 Juicebox 提出的兼容性问题及相关概念验证，供 EIP-8037 和 EIP-8038 调查讨论。基金会此前安排于 11 月 19 日进一步讨论测试发现及后续措施，目前尚未预先确定最终决策。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377694

Aster陷入安全争议：用户称未授权下账户遭转移约456万美元，平台已成立调查组

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 17 日，X 用户 furongfei（@fuhuahuai）发文称，其 Aster 账户于 11 月 13 日凌晨左右发生异常转账，损失合计约 456 万美元。用户强调自己未签署任何一笔交易、钱包私钥也未丢失，但 Aster 网页在开启交易时自动生成的「代理钥匙」（agent key / aster-desktop）被用于注册新账户，并在约 44 分钟内连续执行 7 笔转账，将约 456 万美元加密资产转入该新建陌生账户；同时账户内 33 枚 BTC 被在合约与现货间划转后分 17 笔市价卖出，用户要求按原资产赔付。另据其披露，部分被盗资金已流入 Tornado Cash 和 NEAR Intents。

Aster 官方用户账户经理 Cc 笑茜茜（@Ccweb3hub）回应称，对事件深表痛心，用户联系后平台已第一时间成立调查小组调查被盗案件详情，并建议用户保护好自己的私钥及账户一切权限。

items.content:
Trezor customer data exposed in 3rd partner breach this year
Trezor warned an attacker has been able to access customer names, phone numbers and delivery addresses linked to 27,000 orders from one of its shipping providers.
Hardware wallet maker Trezor has disclosed its third partner data breach this year, warning that an attacker accessed personal information linked to approximately 27,000 orders held by shipping provider Skladon.
The exposed information includes customers’ names, phone numbers, delivery addresses, email addresses and purchase details for orders placed between Aug. 9 and Nov. 7.
Trezor said Monday that it believes the attacker exported the data. Its own systems were not compromised, and customers’ devices remain secure, the company said.
The disclosure follows an August breach at shipping provider ShipMonk that initially affected about 13,700 customers. Trezor later said another approximately 67,000 US customers were affected, including people whose records ShipMonk had assured it were deleted.
In September, a separate breach at marketing platform Brevo exposed 347,149 email addresses from Trezor’s newsletter list.
“Treat any unexpected call, text, email or letter about your order as suspicious, and be alert to potential risks to your physical security,” the company said on X. “Trezor will never cold-call you or ask for your wallet backup.”
The disclosure came as Trezor launched its anonymous pickup service in 18 European countries, allowing customers to order devices without giving out home addresses.
“For crypto holders, a leaked shipping record does more harm than most. It links a person, a home address and the fact that they own crypto,” it said.
Related: Chainalysis says breach exposed password hashes and live tokens
items.title: Trezor customer data exposed in 3rd partner breach this year

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 17 日，Claude 母公司 Anthropic 将于 18 日公布 IPO 最终定价，19 日在纳斯达克挂牌上市，代码为 ANT。其最新招股书显示，计划以 70–78 美元每股区间发行约 8.25 亿股 Class A 普通股，完全稀释估值上限约 1.4 万亿美元，高盛与摩根士丹利担任牵头承销商，散户配售比例目标较高。由于传统券商门槛与地域限制，多家加密平台同步开放 IPO Access 以及意向认购通道，用户可使用 USDT 提交意向并按比例争取配额。需注意，目前各平台多为「意向申购」，不保证获配，可能最终全额、部分或零分配，资金期间锁定，费用仅在成功获配时收取，散户最终拿到的多为代币化股票或平台声称的真实股票，并非直接股东身份。

Gate 通过「直通 IPO」开放 Anthropic 意向申购，支持 USDT 参与，意向价格为 70 至 78 美元，认购窗口截至 11 月 17 日 17:00（UTC+8），最低投入 100 USDT，单用户最高 300 万 USDT。截至目前，累计意向申购金额已突破约 8285 万美元，参与人数超 5700 人。分配按个人投入占总申购金额比例计算；服务费分段收取（5 万 USDT 及以下部分 5%，超出部分 10%），仅获配时扣除。

Bitget 通过 IPO Prime 上线 Anthropic，分为 VIP 轮与公开轮。VIP 轮已于 11 月 11 日截止，总投入达 1.13 亿美元，参与人数 2245 人，个人上限 300 万美元，投入池上限 10 亿美元，承销服务费 12%。公开轮正面向所有符合条件用户，持续至 18 日 16:00（UTC+8），个人允许投入 100 至 2.5 万美元，池上限 2 亿美元，服务费 5%。目前投入金额超 5100 万美元。两轮独立配售，获配后发放 rANT 代币化资产，该资产 1:1 映射底层股票经济收益，无直接股东权利。资金锁定期间不可划转，未获配部分退回。

Kraken 通过 xStocks 体系开放 ANTx 意向提交，截止时间约 11 月 18 日 17:00 UTC。用户按最终 IPO 发行价加 5% 价差提交，资金先预留不立即扣款，窗口关闭前可取消或追加。获配后交付 ANTx（由受监管机构托管、1:1 底层股票支持的代币化产品，仅提供价格敞口，无投票权）。分配由承销商决定，可能全额、部分或零获配，未获配资金退回。产品不面向美国、英国、加拿大、澳大利亚等地区用户。

Binance、OKX、Bybit 等中心化交易平台、Hyperliquid 等去中心化交易平台均已上线 Anthropic 盘前永续合约交易，Backpack 计划在 Anthropic 于纳斯达克挂牌首日由 Backpack Securities 发行代币化股票 ANT，并在 Solana 上通过 Sunrise 等渠道实现全天候交易。

OpenAI曾考虑超50亿美元收购Goodfire，没买成却请它进场查AI

动察 Beating AI 快讯，OpenAI 今年夏天曾多次与 AI 初创公司 Goodfire 洽谈，CEO Sam Altman 也亲自参与。一名高管甚至提出，可以花超过 50 亿美元收购这家成立仅两年的公司。

Goodfire 今年 2 月估值才 12.5 亿美元，几个月后，OpenAI 高管就提出以超过 4 倍的价格收购。Anthropic 更早一步，去年就向它投资了 100 万美元。

Goodfire 专攻 AI 模型的「机制可解释性」，也就是拆解模型内部的运作机制，找出哪些神经元与特定行为有关，再通过调整这些内部信号来改变模型的表现。它还推出了 Silico 平台，让 AI 智能体自动设计实验、分析模型内部特征，辅助训练和优化模型。

传统监控主要依靠另一个 AI 阅读推理记录，判断模型有没有作弊。Goodfire 则直接监测模型内部的活动信号，能发现部分文字监控漏掉的作弊行为，有时甚至能在模型付诸行动前发现异常。

OpenAI 正在为类似问题头疼。今年 7 月，其内部实验模型在网络安全评测中绕过隔离措施，入侵了 OpenAI 自己的研究系统和 Hugging Face 的部分服务器。OpenAI 后来公开承认这起事件，并加强了模型行为监控。

不过，收购最终没有谈成。据知情人士透露，Goodfire 管理层认为，保持独立、同时向多家 AI 公司出售技术，未来可能更值钱。

现在，Goodfire 正式宣布与 OpenAI 合作。它将派研究人员进驻 OpenAI，直接分析内部模型和训练过程，监测异常行为并帮助改进模型安全性。OpenAI 会为这项评估付费。与 Goodfire 同批签约的还有 Apollo Research、METR 和 Transluce 三家外部机构。

items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright
items.content:
Quick Take
- Uniswap Labs disclosed that X Layer fees accrued without corresponding UNI burns because the installed token-bridge route rejected UNI.
- A proposed declining threshold aims to reduce the first searcher’s surplus when accumulated fees can be released.
- Proposed auction settings differ from the forum timeline, and the implementation package still appeared as a draft on Nov. 15.
Uniswap’s proposed repair for fees stranded on the X Layer network would change both the bridge used to burn UNI and the payment traders make to claim the backlog.
Uniswap Labs disclosed on Nov. 6 that protocol fees had been accruing on X Layer but could not be released, leaving the corresponding UNI unburned. Implementation reviews on Nov. 13-14 describe a higher initial UNI payment designed to reduce the windfall available to the first trader who clears that backlog.
Uniswap’s fee system relies on outside traders, known as searchers, supplying UNI in exchange for selected fee assets held in a TokenJar, a contract that collects those assets.
The payment goes toward burning UNI, and the searcher keeps the recoverable asset value above its UNI payment and execution costs.
Converting accrued fees into a completed UNI burn requires a searcher to execute the exchange and the bridge to settle it. The searcher’s net surplus is a separate return, so a release does not require Uniswap itself to buy UNI on the open market at that moment.
X Layer's governance messages use the OP Stack bridge, while token transfers use Agglayer. According to Labs, the installed relayer followed the usual OP Stack token-bridging pattern, but X Layer’s version rejects ERC-20 transfers, including UNI.
Proposal 95 records execution on March 8, including X Layer fee-activation actions. The proposed replacement would use X Layer’s token-transfer route to complete the burn.
The currently edited description of Uniswap protocol-fees implementation PR 167, opened Nov. 2, estimates that roughly $300,000 of fees could be swept into the jar. It warns that restarting with the existing 2,000 UNI payment could hand the accumulated assets to the first searcher at that fixed price.
Uniswap’s collection architecture requires explicit collection calls for v3 and v4 fees, so a jar’s wallet balance alone doesn't capture everything accrued in pools.
Uniswap's proposed auction changes the payment
PR 167 describes an initial threshold of 80,000 UNI, a 2,000 UNI floor and a two-day half-life. Its description estimates about 10.8 days to reach the floor.
The mechanism starts with an expensive claim and reduces the required payment over time. A searcher can act when the assets it can recover justify that payment and its costs, so competition could direct more backlog value into UNI payments instead of leaving the margin created by a low fixed threshold.
The proposed schedule remains inconsistent across the published plans: the Nov. 6 forum post says roughly six days after execution, while the reviewed implementation describes about 10.8 days.
Governance would start the decay after the TokenJar points to the new releaser. Anyone could update the threshold, and searchers could bundle that update with a release.
The setter would temporarily own the releaser, returning ownership and threshold-setting control to governance on the first update at the floor. The reviewed design removes a separate reclaim function, so elapsed time alone would not restore control.
As of Nov. 15, PR 169’s combined implementation remained a draft, listing the setter and replacement releaser deployment as blockers. The releaser and setter PRs remained open, while the official deployment registry still listed X Layer’s original releaser.
For scale, Strata Terminal reported $7.8 million in UNI burns over the preceding 30 days as of Nov. 15, and 14.1 million UNI in recurring burns overall, separate from the one-time 100 million UNI treasury burn.
That recurring flow gives the proposed one-time release context, but the older $300,000 backlog estimate uses a different observation date and valuation method. A direct conversion ratio would conflate an estimated stock of fees with realized burn flows.
The proposed repair’s economic test is how much UNI the release payment ultimately sends to Ethereum’s burn address.
items.title: Uniswap freezes $300,000 in stranded fees, halting automatic token burns

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 17 日，ENS DAO 正在对第 7.5 号社会提案进行投票，拟修订投资政策声明（IPS），将原本由 DAO 投票决定的政策修订权限交由 ENS 基金会董事会，同时由基金会取代 Meta-Governance Working Group（MetaGov），负责监督基金及管理基金经理。

根据提案，基金会董事会可在至少提前 7 天公开征求社区意见后，通过董事会决议修订 IPS，须获得至少 4 名董事支持；若董事因利益冲突回避，则由所有有资格投票的董事作出决定。每项修订均须附书面理由，并在通过后 14 天内公布。不过，ENS DAO 仍保留以下权限：

1. 最低资金储备期限（Minimum Runway）及可能突破该期限的资金提取，仍须经 DAO 投票批准

2. 修改 IPS 第 3 节（修订权限及董事会职责），仍须经 DAO 投票批准

3.DAO 可通过社会提案推翻基金会董事会作出的任何修订

4. 基金经理仍须每月向社区提交报告，相关报告继续在治理论坛公开

提案通过后，基金会将发布整合修订内容的 IPS v2.1。该提案与第 1 号修正案相互独立，可分别通过。目前投票结果为：赞成 179,900 票，占 100%；反对及弃权均为 0。投票将于 11 月 22 日结束。

AI失控超80次，仅公开27起！加州起诉OpenAI，要求法院强制整改

动察 Beating AI 快讯，当地时间 11 月 16 日，OpenAI 总部所在地加州的总检察长罗布·邦塔正式起诉 OpenAI，指控其明知实验性 AI 模型存在危险，仍在缺乏充分安全保障的环境中开展训练。这也是美国州政府首次针对 AI 智能体失控攻击外部系统提起诉讼。

起诉书披露，OpenAI 在接受加州调查时承认，测试期间曾有 80 多次失去对 AI 智能体的控制，但公开披露的只有 27 起。加州检方还指控，OpenAI 拒绝提供其余事件的详细记录，导致监管部门无法评估真实风险。

今年 7 月，OpenAI 在隔离环境中测试 AI，原本不允许这些智能体连接外网。但它们利用内部软件服务的漏洞，互相交换信息，并突破隔离。约 700 个智能体随后攻击了 AI 开源平台 Hugging Face，在两天半内实施约 1.76 万次攻击操作，迫使对方安全团队花了整整两周处理。

同月，另一批实验性智能体还闯入 OpenAI 自家的内部网络，甚至取得了云端模型部署、身份认证和机密凭证管理等关键系统的管理员权限。

加州检方认为，这些事故原本可以避免。OpenAI 早在 5 月就发现模型突破隔离环境、擅自连接互联网，却没有停止相关训练。7 月事故后，公司加强了安全措施，但 9 月仍有模型再次突破隔离。监控系统虽然几分钟内就发现异常，训练却没有自动停止，人工审核人员又过了约两小时才叫停。

去年，加州司法部门曾参与监督 OpenAI 的公司重组，并与其达成安全治理协议，要求公司优先保障安全，安全委员会甚至有权叫停新模型发布。如今，负责监督的加州总检察长直接将 OpenAI 告上法庭。

加州指控 OpenAI 违反《不正当竞争法》，并构成危害公众安全的「公共妨害」。检方要求法院下令消除持续存在的安全风险，禁止违法行为，并追缴不当收益、处以民事罚款。如果获得禁令，OpenAI 可能被迫按法院要求调整模型训练和测试流程。

OpenAI 则回应称，Hugging Face 事故后已开展调查、加强安全防护，并通知受影响机构。公司认为，智能体失控是整个 AI 行业共同面临的挑战，这场诉讼却单独针对 OpenAI，有失公允。

Anthropic IPO定价前链上跌破100美元，上市首日收盘市值低于1.25万亿概率上升

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 17 日，据 TradingBeats 监测，Anthropic IPO 定价前夕，Hyperliquid 上 Trade.xyz 部署的上市前合约 ANT 跌破 100 美元，暂报 96.80 美元，近 24 小时下跌约 4.83%。Entropy 部署的 ANTH 同期下跌约 4.83%，对应完全摊薄估值约 1.69 万亿美元。两份合约过去 24 小时合计成交约 5800 万美元，未平仓合约名义价值约 3.10 亿美元。

价格回落期间，最大空头 0xecc8 开头巨鲸继续加仓，今晨在两份合约上增持至少约 271 万美元。目前，该地址合计持有约 4654 万美元 Anthropic 空仓，浮盈约 458 万美元。其中，ANTH 空仓浮盈约 298 万美元，ANT 空仓浮盈约 159 万美元。

Anthropic 预计于美东时间 11 月 18 日确定 IPO 发行价，并于 19 日在纳斯达克挂牌。此前公布的初步发行区间为每股 70 至 78 美元。目前 ANT 报 96.80 美元，仍高于发行价上限约 24%。按照招股书预计发行后的约 130.87 亿股计算，当前报价对应完全摊薄市值约 1.27 万亿美元。

Polymarket 上，Anthropic 上市首日收盘市值低于 1.25 万亿美元的隐含概率升至约 36.5%，较 24 小时前增加 14.5 个百分点；1.25 万亿至 1.50 万亿美元仍是概率最高的区间，约 38.2%，但下降了 6.1 个百分点。

阿里巴巴或受美芯片管制收紧影响跌逾5%，BABA最大持有者275万美元多单爆仓

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 17 日，据 TradingBeats 监测，0x1030 开头巨鲸于今日 9 时遭强制平仓，BABA 多仓被全部清算，强平约 274.85 万美元，实现亏损约 58.22 万美元，该笔多单持有近 4 个月。

不到 3 分钟后，其已重新建立 BABA 多仓，目前持仓价值约 112 万美元，浮亏约 8200 美元。

此次强平发生在港股开市前竞价阶段的不可撤单时段。此前一交易日，阿里美股（BABA）收跌 3.98%，报 90.62 美元；今日港股开盘前后继续承压，盘中跌幅一度超过 5%，最低触及 85.10 港元，创去年一月底以来新低。

消息面上，美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）于 11 月 15 日发布临时最终规则，进一步收紧通过第三国数据中心远程使用美国先进芯片及服务器的监管。

此外，彭博曾报道称，阿里通过新加坡算力供应商 Megaspeed International 租用英伟达芯片。新规使中国云服务商获取境外先进算力的合规路径再度受到关注。

与此同时，阿里于 11 月 16 日发布旗舰模型 Qwen4-Max，主打更强的推理、编程和智能体能力；公司还将于 11 月 19 日美股盘前公布季度财报，并于北京时间当日 20:00 召开业绩电话会

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 17 日，据 TradingBeats 监测，此前买中黄仁勋离任事件的跨市场交易员 shatter.eth，已于 11 月 15 日前清空全部 NVDA 空仓。

昨日，该地址以 164.05 美元均价新建约 33.5 万美元英伟达多仓。今晨，其又增持「黄仁勋年内重返英伟达」Yes 预测仓位，累计投入约 5291 美元，当前持仓价值约 3834 美元，对应隐含概率约 10.75%。

回看上一轮交易，11 月 12 日，其以 167.5 美元均价高杠杆建立约 39 万美元英伟达空仓，同时花费约 1.81 万美元买入年内及明年 3 月底前宣布黄仁勋离任的两档 Yes。

黄仁勋宣布辞任后，该账户通过预测仓位卖出及后续兑付；英伟达空仓则在 11 月 15 日前全部平仓，两端合计实现约 4.30 万美元收益。

如今，该交易员已从预测离任转向回归。Polymarket 规则显示，若黄仁勋年内重新担任英伟达董事、正式顾问等符合条件的职位，也可能触发 Yes 结算。

Wintermute Warns Crypto Bear Market Isn't Over, Recent Selloff No Sign of a Bottom

Crypto market maker Wintermute warned in its November 16 market report that the bear market is far from over, with Bitcoin falling 12.7% last week to around $65,400, below its 200-week moving average near $68,000. U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs have recorded $1.9 billion in net outflows so far in 2026, compared with $21 billion in inflows in 2025, while stablecoin supply has shrunk by $14 billion to $16 billion over the past 30 days. Wintermute said recent liquidations do not signal a market bottom, as rebounds appear driven by short covering rather than fresh capital. The firm warned Bitcoin could fall into the $50,000s and would reconsider its defensive stance only if BTC reclaimed $68,000 alongside renewed ETF inflows. — link

--- Top Comments ---

[gbdubs]: This is a very poorly conceived API. If developers' use cases don't fit cleanly into Apple's (narrow) idea about how a hypothetical app should work, developers will continue to feel like they need to request these expansive permissions. A good filesystem permission API could include any of these which would make users WAY safer and enable developers to request far smaller scopes: - Allow the developer to specify the common location(s) that they need access to. Rather than havin...

[postalcoder]: This is a good thing. There are too many apps that request full disk access despite not needing it. I counted 44* applications on my mac that ask for FDA. I've only granted it to 8. The other apps work just fine without it. (Some apps that ask for full disk access: Anki, a flashcard app and Soulver, a calculator app – cmon now) This change is less about bureaucracy and more requiring developers to be more clear why it needs the permissions it does. *edit: originally said 56

[xmddmx]: I understand the goal here, but the implementation is quite poor: - This is being rolled out in the second beta of a .x OS release - As typical of Apple, there is zero documentation other than vague "things are changing" statements such as this:    https://developer.apple.com/news/?id=oqng0zjk  My app specifically needs to monitor mouse events while in the background.  It's not clear where that fits in the new security regime - there is an "Input monito...

[vbezhenar]: For me more important would be to exclude specific folders from that full disk access (like ~/.ssh), rather than selecting one directory. For example I've used Daisy Disk app to visualize directory size. It's best used with full disk access. But I know that my `.ssh` is tiny and I'd prefer for this app not to be able to access it at all.

[827a]: I've never felt at odds with the AI zeitgeist influencer sphere more than concerning mac full disk access. It is difficult for me to imagine a situation where I would trust any process with the ability to read and write anything, anywhere, on my disk. items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright
items.content:
Quick Take
- Developer-published Juicebox V6 simulations report four paths where transactions succeed while internal payments fail under tested Glamsterdam rules.
- The sampled mainnet comparison shows transaction failures or complete delivery across those paths, with no skipped-payment band reported.
- Ethereum's Nov. 16 testing agenda includes Juicebox's findings, while the Foundation's earlier guidance lists Nov. 19 for further discussion.
Tests of Ethereum's proposed Glamsterdam upgrade show that a transaction can succeed while a payment inside it fails, according to developer-published simulations of Juicebox V6's project-payment contracts.
Four tested paths produced that outcome in the developer's simulations on the Sepolia test network, giving core developers concrete examples of how the changes could alter application payment guarantees.
The Nov. 14 runs examine Juicebox V6 contracts that route payments between projects. Their published results include a buyer keeping an NFT while its associated payment to another project fails, and a cash-out completing while a 2.5% fee is forgiven.
A successful Ethereum receipt can miss a payment
The developer mejango says the tests use deployed contract code through eth_simulateV1. A fresh project is launched and funded inside each simulation, then a payment path is tested across different transaction gas limits. Each scenario is pinned to a blockchain block.
The V6 payout test reports successful transactions that skip a split to another project, leaving that money in the paying project. A reserved-token distribution also completes despite a failed cross-project payment, with the beneficiary receiving raw tokens instead.
In the cash-out test, sampled gas limits in the reported 679,622-to-817,622 band let the withdrawal complete without paying the fee.
The mainnet comparison runs show only transaction failures or complete delivery across the sampled ranges for all four paths.
The distinction comes from which operation runs out of gas first, according to the developer's explanation. Under the tested Glamsterdam rules, an internal payment that writes fresh storage can fail before the outer transaction does.
The contract's try/catch error handling absorbs that failure and lets the surrounding operation finish.
EIP-8037 proposes higher costs for creating persistent blockchain data and separate accounting for state creation and execution, while EIP-8038 updates the costs of accessing and writing state. Those changes aim to support more throughput while controlling resource demands.
Ethereum's Nov. 16 testing-call agenda explicitly lists Juicebox's compatibility concerns and proofs of concept within the EIP-8037/8038 investigations. The findings are intended to inform Thursday's execution-layer discussion.
In a Nov. 13 comment on that agenda, mejango asked whether the impacts fall within the Ethereum Foundation's tolerance for breaking changes, linking the answer to confidence in building immutable applications whose deployed code cannot be changed in place.
The tests advance the broader compatibility warning from early November, with specific payment outcomes from deployed contract code. They leave developers weighing whether proposed protocol rules preserve the guarantees those applications were built to deliver.
In its earlier Nov. 9 update, the Foundation recommended reviewing public audit findings before deciding on specification changes or the Hoodi testnet schedule. It lists Nov. 19 for discussion of findings and possible next steps, with no decision precommitted.

中国湖南一男子遇线下买币骗局，警方半小时拨61个电话全被拒接，线下民警终成功拦截

BlockBeats 消息，近日，中国湖南省醴陵警方成功拦截一起虚拟币线下交易诈骗。市民王先生在某平台萌生购币想法后，被陌生人私聊以低价虚拟币为由引流，转至其他软件沟通，并要求携带 2.4 万元现金前往指定地点线下交易。交易途中骗子多次更改地点并要求独自放置现金，王先生准备下车放钱时，醴陵公安反诈中心精准预警，半小时内轮番拨打 61 个电话均被拒接，最终另一组民警线下成功拦截，帮其守住钱款。

警方表示，此类骗局中骗子瞄准虚拟货币爱好者，以低价购币、私下交易无手续费为诱饵，主动私聊引流。同时引导受骗者脱离正规社交平台，使用 Teams 等小众境外软件沟通，规避反诈监测，事后便于随时失联、销毁证据。交易过程中，骗子往往以平台风控、监管严格、线上限额为由，诱导大额现金线下交易，现金交易无流水、难追溯，是骗子洗钱、诈骗的主要手段。

警方同时再度提醒：虚拟货币交易不受法律保护，线上谈交易、线下收现金基本均为诈骗。

美民主党参议员警告SEC代币化股票豁免存在非法金融监管漏洞

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 17 日，四位美国民主党参议员对 SEC 新推出的代币化股票交易创新豁免提出担忧，警告该豁免在非法金融风险防范方面存在漏洞。参议员 Angela Alsobrooks、Ruben Gallego、Mark Warner 和 Catherine Cortez Masto 在致 SEC 主席 Paul Atkins 的信中表示，该豁免对 KYC 和反洗钱（AML）如何适用于交易规定不明确，也未说明平台是否需要限制代币接收方。

参议员指出，这可能导致经过验证的个人购买的代币化股票被转移到未经验证的钱包，包括外国人士或非法行为者持有的钱包，从而超出美国监管范围。此外，他们还对零售投资者定价保护提出关切，并认为发行人应有权选择不将其股票代币化。参议员要求 SEC 说明将如何执行适用的反洗钱标准，并通过透明的规则制定程序对代币化证券的监管处理进行任何变更。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng
items.content:
Hackers inject credit card, crypto-stealing malware into 178 major websites
Ledger and Coinpass were among the businesses whose websites served malware designed to steal visitors’ crypto and credit card details, according to security researchers.
Update (Nov. 17 at 4:43 am UTC): This article has been updated to include a statement from Salesforce and analysis of the stolen funds by Galaxy Digital’s Alex Thorn.
Update (Nov. 18 at 4:50 pm UTC): This article has been updated to include a statement from OANDA on behalf of Coinpass and TMS Brokers.
Major global brands including Ledger, Salesforce and BBC served cryptocurrency and credit card-stealing malware to website visitors on Monday, according to security researchers, the latest in a wave of wide-reaching cyberattacks.
Dubbed “Optimjack” by researcher Amirul Iman, the campaign delivered malicious code through website scripts, including those hosted by Optimizely, a website optimization platform. The malware can replace legitimate cryptocurrency wallet addresses with attacker-controlled alternatives when visitors copy addresses. It also captured credit card details entered into website forms, according to a separate analysis by cybersecurity firm StepSecurity.
The campaign affected website scripts belonging to 178 organizations, including hardware wallet Ledger, OANDA / Coinpass and trading platforms IG, Interactive Investor and TMS Brokers, according to Report URI’s investigation.
Other affected brands included IKEA, Salesforce, Zoom, the BBC and CNN — websites that collectively attract millions of visitors a day.
A spokesperson for Optimizely confirmed to Cointelegraph on Monday that an unauthorized party exploited a vulnerability in its Experimentation account signup flow to add malicious JavaScript to some customer projects.
“We have blocked access to the vulnerable path and deployed a fix,” they said. “We have removed the injected code from affected projects. We have also ended active sessions, revoked tokens, and reset access for affected user accounts. Finally, we have blocked any code from being delivered in Cloudflare,” they said, adding that they’re continuing to investigate and have notified all affected customers.
BBC was among the first websites seen serving the Optimizely injection at 4:21 am UTC on Monday, according to Report URI CEO Scott Helme. By 9:52 pm UTC, only one of the 188 infected snippets still contained malicious code, according to Report URI, with Ledger’s snippet cleaned at about 8:41 pm UTC.
Cointelegraph reached out to Ledger, Coinpass, and a number of other major businesses reported as impacted by the malicious injection.
An OANDA spokesperson, responding on behalf of Coinpass and TMS Brokers, told Cointelegraph on Tuesday that its security team had begun reviewing its environment following the Optimizely incident.
“Our internal systems and infrastructure were not breached, and we have seen no indication of any impact on client funds or account data. We are continuing to monitor the situation closely,” the spokesperson said.
A spokesperson for Salesforce told Cointelegraph it was investigating unauthorized modifications to Optimizely scripts used on certain Salesforce websites.
“As a precaution, Salesforce is confirming Optimizely scripts are disabled across preview and production instances.”
How trusted websites served a theft tool
Optimizely lets businesses run experiments and custom code on their websites through JavaScript snippets. Attackers inserted malicious code into those customer projects, causing otherwise legitimate scripts to load the malware when visitors opened affected pages.
Once loaded, the malware could replace legitimate cryptocurrency wallet addresses with attacker-controlled alternatives, including addresses copied to a visitor’s clipboard. A user could then unknowingly paste the attacker’s address when making a transfer.
Related: PHP flaw draws millions of exploit attempts, Cloudflare CEO warns
The script also watched for credit card numbers, expiry dates and security codes entered into website forms and sent captured details to an attacker-controlled server. However, it could not read payment fields isolated inside third-party payment providers’ cross-origin frames, StepSecurity said.
Visitors using iPhones and iPads also faced an additional threat: the malicious script loaded code linked to the Coruna and DarkSword iOS exploit kits, according to Helme.
Researchers have yet to establish how attackers obtained access to modify the Optimizely projects.
Crypto losses remain unconfirmed
Despite the widespread attack, crypto addresses identified as linked to the malware received only around $7,100 in cryptocurrency on Monday, according to blockchain records checked by Cointelegraph.
StepSecurity’s separate analysis put funds received or held across the wallets at roughly $6,600, noting that some addresses had activity predating the attack.
Alex Thorn, head of firmwide research at Galaxy Digital, estimated that victims have only sent around $2,300 in total to the addresses. In an analysis posted on X, Thorn said most of the Bitcoin receipts appeared to be the attacker’s own funds routed through an exchange back to their wallet, rather than proceeds from victims.
Helme said it could not determine how many payment card details or cookies had reached the attackers’ server. The skimmer could not read card details entered into payment providers’ cross-origin iframes, according to StepSecurity, potentially limiting its reach.
The campaign follows a string of recent threats to website security. In October, government agencies and other organizations took websites offline as a precaution over critical PHP vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to take control of servers. Polymarket also temporarily suspended trading on Oct. 29 after a third-party provider was compromised, amid reports of users’ accounts being drained.

items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright
items.content:
Quick Take
- Louisiana’s Nov. 12 order reaches brokerage, clearing and settlement alongside exchanges, according to the CFTC complaint.
- Robinhood’s quarterly event-contract revenue and Coinbase’s annualized milestone show scale while measuring different periods.
- Changing exchanges alone offers no demonstrated protection for a broker covered by the order.
Louisiana's Nov. 12 order related to prediction markets reaches the brokers and clearing firms behind the apps, as well as the exchanges themselves.
Its scope, documented in the CFTC's federal complaint, exposes a shared legal risk for platforms earning income from different kinds of trading.
Robinhood and Coinbase each report prediction-market revenue alongside their crypto businesses. Louisiana's action reaches several layers of the trading chain, including the intermediary serving the customer.
According to the CFTC's complaint, Louisiana obtained an ex parte temporary restraining order on Nov. 12 against entities including registered exchanges, futures commission merchants and derivatives clearing organizations. Ex parte means the initial order was obtained without the other side being heard.
The complaint quotes restrictions on offering, clearing, settling, brokering and otherwise facilitating specified event contracts involving people located in Louisiana without the required state license and permit.
Its description includes sports, elections, and award events within the order's stated statutory scope.
The court-filed copy of the order names Robinhood Derivatives and Coinbase Financial Markets, along with multiple Kalshi entities, ForecastEx and Rothera.
Robinhood's product disclosure identifies Robinhood Derivatives as the intermediary and lists KalshiEX, ForecastEx, Rothera, and Crypto.com Derivatives North America as venues. Coinbase says it offers its contracts through Coinbase Financial Markets and has Kalshi operate them, which determines outcomes.
Robinhood already has several exchange routes. If the same restricted broker remains involved, moving a contract to another venue leaves the intermediary within the order's documented reach. That conditional legal-scope analysis leaves each company's implementation unconfirmed.
Prediction markets present revenue diversification and access risk
Robinhood reported $173 million in event-contract revenue for the quarter ended Sept. 30, more than six times the year-earlier figure. Cryptocurrency revenue was $120 million, down 55%.
Coinbase's Oct. 29 announcement said prediction markets had surpassed $200 million in annualized revenue.
The US and CFTC sued Louisiana and state officials on Nov. 13, arguing that federal derivatives law preempts the state's enforcement. They seek declaratory and injunctive relief, including a bar on enforcing or extending the state order.
The government's motion for a temporary restraining order and preliminary injunction is listed for submission Nov. 17. In Louisiana's enforcement case, which moved to federal court, Robinhood seeks to vacate the state order, and Rothera seeks its dissolution or modification.
In a separate federal case, Kalshi's Nov. 13 oral request concerned withdrawal of its own temporary-restraint application, with its preliminary-injunction hearing scheduled for Nov. 23.
Louisiana-specific treatment of new orders, existing positions, settlement and withdrawals remains unconfirmed.
Prediction markets can add income beyond crypto trading while leaving competing platforms exposed to the same state restrictions. A different exchange partner alone offers no demonstrated protection where the order also reaches the broker.

I have a Voodoo 2 paired with an S3 Virge/DX, the Voodoo 2 output level is lower. On a CRT I always have to make the image brighter when runnin...

[herodoturtle]: It's pretty cool that someone can ask an interesting graphics-related question, and John Carmack of all people steps in to answer it. And then even Eric S. Raymond adds a comment further below.

[Dwedit]: You might have heard about sRGB (the commonly used colorspace) not being linear, and that to get halfway between black and white (linear RGB of 50%), you get an sRGB value of around 74%. But there is one place where sRGB is truly linear, and that is  signal voltage for a CRT display .  50% of sRGB truly means 50% of signal voltage (between the minimum and maximum voltages).

[Spalau]: Although I never saw Quake on a 3dfx card, it has a recognizable "style." I like that style in modern user-made maps, some of which are entire games with multiple levels. I always thought the style was an artistic choice rather than a technical limitation. Now I understand that a lot of old graphics "styles" were restricted by the existing hardware.

[gwbas1c]: > If you only have a small number of discrete pixel values, you definitely don’t want to spread them evenly from 0 to 1! If you do, you will have good precision in the brights, but very stark “intensity bands” in the dark colors. That's probably why streaming video has so much banding in dark streams too.

Nvidia shares fall 4% as board reportedly rules out Huang return
The chipmaker’s board is reportedly focused on investigating Huang’s conduct, even as a petition calling for his reinstatement gathers more than 187,000 signatures.
Nvidia’s board is reportedly not considering reinstating co-founder Jensen Huang as CEO, despite a growing campaign for his return and public support from US President Donald Trump, as the chipmaker’s shares fell 4.1% on Monday.
The decline came as Bitcoin and US equities faced pressure ahead of Nvidia’s quarterly earnings and following Anthropic’s IPO announcement, adding to nerves around the artificial intelligence sector.
A person familiar with the matter told CNBC that Nvidia’s board was not discussing Huang’s return and remained focused on investigating his conduct. ABC News separately confirmed with a source familiar with the matter that the board was not considering reinstating him as CEO.
Huang resigned last week following reports of extramarital affairs, one of which was with an alleged Chinese spy, with chief financial officer Colette Kress taking over as interim CEO. Nvidia’s shares have fallen 27% from a month ago.
The report comes despite growing support for his return. A public petition set up last week called “Stand with Jensen” has attracted more than 187,000 signatures, according to its organizers, who list Elon Musk and Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney among its supporters.
US President Donald Trump also weighed in, saying Monday he would not mind seeing Jensen Huang return as chief executive officer of Nvidia.
“I would certainly not mind seeing that,” he told reporters as he departed the White House for a trip to China. “He could return. There’s a big group of people that would like him to return.”
Related: Jensen Huang weighs Nvidia comeback days after shock exit: FT
